# Wiki-Memory L3 Profile

[Wiki-Memory L3 Profile]{.prefLabel}

The canonical L3 reference profile for the cogitarelink-solid Pod. Sits on top of the L2 memory substrate and pins concrete URI layout, slug algorithm, and SHACL shape catalog.

Parent: [[Agentic Memory Systems MOC]]{.broader}

The convergence of independent traditions (Karpathy LLM Wiki, Ghumare's extension, AKBP, agentmemory) onto the same substrate is empirical evidence that W3C web standards are the natural carrier for wiki-memory. See [[Ghumare - LLM Wiki v2 Extending Karpathy]]{.source} for the most direct precursor.

Author of the foundational pattern: [[karpathy-andrej]]{.author}.

## Key commitments

- Page-as-unit with dual-layer linking (markdown body + RDF in .meta)
- Standards-first vocabulary (DCT/SKOS/CiTO/FOAF/PROV)
- Substrate-derived navigation (Hub, breadcrumb)
- Predicate-level governance (Model A)
